vacancy.title: Photonic EEEE Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC A2-A4 hardware and qualification role with laboratory tests, technology R&D, project reviews and industrial activity monitoring. Relevant to optics and engineering background, but highly specialised in photonic EEEE parts, lasers, fibre optics, CCD/CMOS/IR detectors and component reliability; MSc Mechanical Engineering and broad design experience are not a close substitute for four years of photonics/electronics expertise. Specialist stretch; 4-year contract extendable to indefinite.
